text:
alex: kicking off green-swap for router (us-west1) now. change window until 22:00 UTC. plan: 10% -> 40% -> 80% -> 100% with 5m holds. target config: green-v2 (pinned v2.1.3). cookie-affinity will remain enabled for sessions. @sre-oncall please monitor errors/latency. deploy-bot will post each step.

deploy-bot: [info] starting traffic shift id=swap-2026-03-20-21:00 step=1 weights set -> {"green-v2":0.10, "blue-v1":0.90} router-change-id=rc-8943

ben: quick check — initial telemetry looks normal. p50 22ms / p95 87ms / p99 160ms. error rate steady ~0.01%. no GC blips on green nodes.

maya: seeing a small bump in 429s from oauth-proxy at 10% (mostly from mobile clients). could be retry/backpressure. adding filter to trace for sample request ids. recommend hold at 10% for 5m. :eyes:

sre-oncall: holding at 10% for 5m. dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/routers/green-swap (watch p99, 5xx, queue depth). will escalate on >0.3% 5xx or p99 > 400ms.

deploy-bot: [info] hold reached, no critical alerts. advancing to step=2 -> 40% (weights: green-v2=0.40, blue-v1=0.60)

ben: after 40% bump — latency stable, small increase in auth 429 rate but downstream retry smoothed it. overall error-rate 0.015% (still within SLO). logging looks clean.

alex: noting we need to pin enterprise customers to blue for the next hour as a precaution (session affinity + older cookie schema). applying route-exception for cohort=enterprise now.

deploy-bot: [info] applied route exception: matcher: user.cohort == "enterprise" -> weight {blue-v1:1.0}. exception-id=ex-221.

maya: thanks — traces confirm enterprise sessions continue to hit blue. that should limit exposure.

deploy-bot: [info] advancing to step=3 -> 80% (green-v2=0.80). rolling change implemented.

ben: alert — small spike in 502 from cache-proxy in us-west1 at 80%. p99 up to 520ms for ~30s window. error rate 0.6% localized to cache-proxy.

maya: correlating logs — cache-proxy connection pool exhausted when new green instances ramped up. likely mis-tuned pool size for v2.1.3.

sre-oncall: pausing rollout. rolling back to previous safe point (40%). deploy-bot, revert to weights=40% and mark incident.

deploy-bot: [action] rollback step: weights set -> {"green-v2":0.40, "blue-v1":0.60}. rollback-reason="cache-proxy-502-spike". incident-ticket: INC-4721.

alex: good call. creating short postmortem and plan: tune pool, run internal soak against green nodes, then reattempt swap later in change window if stable. pin noted in release notes: v2.1.3 requires cache-proxy pool bump.

ben: I'll open a PR with pool defaults (kube config) and trigger a canary deploy to a subset of green instances. PR: https://git.redwood/pool-fix.

maya: once pool bump validated we can resume from 40% -> 80% -> 100%, but we'll keep enterprise cohort pinned to blue until full verification. also suggest incremental routing delays: 20m holds at 80%.

sre-oncall: updated incident ticket with timeline. no customer-facing rollback required. will proceed with postmortem after change window. :memo:

alex: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the ops playbook. will re-run swap after PR deploy + soak and post new rollout time in #eng-releases. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [info] final state: partial rollback to 40% complete. live weights: {"green-v2":0.40, "blue-v1":0.60}. state=paused. incident=INC-4721.
